summary:
Read-only routine-delivery inspection previously returned ready before the board-linkage and delivery-declaration gates, which only ran under apply. The prepared repair evaluates the same applicable gate before readiness and the candidate observer. Enforced refusal and Unknown remain distinct; advisory mode, trusted override ordering and nonroutine routes remain unchanged. Inspection performs no writer replay, merge, Status, custody-intent or timer operation. Apply still independently refreshes the native PR envelope and rechecks linkage. Focused controls cover these distinctions and changed-native-state refusal; local full routine tests and all board mutants passed. This is locally qualified source preparation, not merged, installed or fleet acceptance.

Existing owner guidance carries a finite authorized sequence across short observation checkpoints. A checkpoint is not owner retirement or permission to relaunch a workload. Unchanged polling belongs to existing bounded mechanical observation; failure, determining drift, original deadline and truthful stopped-monitor handoff remain explicit. Ordinary isolated diagnosis within the selected envelope needs no approval-by-command. Producer release closure, rather than a main SHA or file-disjointness alone, determines whether a later ancestor-preserving advance can retain the original candidate. Shared Atlas/manifest input changes still require composition and fresh qualification.

Qualification preflight checks the actual selected consumer command/environment, including the public-package branch, and keeps active identities distinct from frozen-fixture and published-predecessor roles. No new monitor, approval layer, telemetry campaign or savings claim follows. The routine helper and work-board guidance are FS.GG.Drivers payload; pipeline-preflight itself is not a registered package member. Source/operator use and any later packaged-instruction adoption remain separate obligations with Root and Delivery5272.

The earlier record cited a local-only preparation revision that was not publicly retrievable. This supersession cites verified source bytes on the normal candidate ancestry instead; it changes no implementation, effect authority or runtime acceptance claim.
title: Inspect landing prerequisites before readiness; retain ownership through bounded observation
